summary: E1 is weak indirect evidence: an outside trader repeated an untraceable warning and could identify neither a first-hand source nor a location. After one visit, it is too early to treat this as a clearance target under the pilot criteria, and there is no evidence of absence meeting cancellation criteria. Recommend further non-technical survey to follow up the report before deciding.
flags: The desk study's nearby accident, zone flag and survey priority are not evidence of contamination within this area; the dossier does not record an accident inside ABE-0294.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.
